subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for both structured reply metadata and no-output/final-fallback semantics, or should it be split/closed in favor of the narrower active items?
rationale: Current main only partially addresses the UI affordance and empty-reply wording; the remaining behavior crosses Control UI, gateway protocol, agent runtime context, and channel delivery contracts already covered by separate active items.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked Work Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker until the structured reply metadata and final fallback delivery decisions are merged or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split To Active Canonicals
options.body: Move the reply-metadata work to the open reply contract issue or PR and the no-output delivery semantics to the final fallback issue, then close this umbrella as superseded.

options.title: Accept Markdown-Only Reply Scope
options.body: Close the structured metadata portion only if maintainers decide Control UI reply behavior should remain a Markdown quote instead of a session/runtime metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked Work Lands
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface tracker until the structured reply metadata and final fallback delivery decisions are merged or explicitly rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent empty-reply delivery work and broad runtime/gateway product history make steipete the best available routing owner for the umbrella/split choice.
